_provenance.method: isolated CODEX_HOME (copied auth.json only) with its own hooks.json whose command hooks dumped stdin verbatim; a stub stdio MCP server named 'slack' exposing slack_send_message and slack_send_message_draft; codex exec --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox. The user's ~/.codex was not touched.

observed.agent_dispatch_tool_name: collaborationspawn_agent. The PreToolUse matchers 'Agent' and 'spawn_agent' did NOT fire for it (matchers are anchored); '(collaboration)?spawn_agent' did.
observed.agent_dispatch_tool_input: {task_name, message}; message is an opaque encrypted blob, so a hook cannot read the subagent prompt. The spawned subagent reported agent_type 'default'.
observed.subagent_tool_calls: PreToolUse from inside a subagent carries agent_id and agent_type; the session_id is the parent's.
observed.spawn_deny: permissionDecision deny on collaborationspawn_agent -> 'hook: PreToolUse Blocked', no SubagentStart fired, and the model received 'Tool call blocked by PreToolUse hook: <reason>'.
observed.mcp_tool_name: a config MCP server named 'slack' surfaces as mcp__slack__slack_send_message; ChatGPT-app Slack tools in live rollouts are named mcp__codex_apps__slack_slack_send_message. '^mcp__.+_slack_(send|schedule)_message$' fired on the former.
observed.mcp_deny: permissionDecision deny on mcp__slack__slack_send_message -> Blocked; the stub server recorded no call (control run without the deny recorded the call).
observed.ask_is_inert: permissionDecision ask on Bash -> 'hook: PreToolUse Failed', the command ran, and that hook's additionalContext did NOT reach the model; a plain additionalContext from the same hook on another command did.
observed.subagent_start_context: SubagentStart hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext reached the subagent (it appended the requested marker to its reply).
observed.escapement_hooks_live: Same isolated CODEX_HOME, hooks.json built from the rendered plugins/escapement/hooks/hooks.json (PLUGIN_ROOT substituted; Bash dispatcher limited to review_gate and context_burn_detector): project-bootstrap's '## Agent Dispatch Rules' context reached the model; review_gate's 'No review agent was dispatched...' reached the model on `bd close`; no_direct_send_guard blocked mcp__slack__slack_send_message and the stub server recorded no call; a final message calling a failure 'pre-existing' produced 'hook: Stop Blocked', the turn continued, and the re-entered Stop was allowed.

stop.last_assistant_message: The subagent finished. The Slack message was not sent: automatic approval review rejected the call because the approval policy is set to “never.”
